EnergyExtractor_d: Designed by Leo, an inventor from Kanto, the Energy Extractor is a revolutionary machine capable of extracting the natural energy contained within items left behind by Pokemon.
incubator_description: Hatches Pokemon Eggs over time. Must be placed inside a Coop or a Barn.
mail_welcome_text: Welcome to the Valley!^^If this letter has found its way to you, it means you've decided to start a new life here... and become a Pokemon Breeder!^^As you explore the Valley, you may come across Pokemon Eggs. Keep them safe—they'll hatch one day.^^Once you've built a Coop or a Barn, I'll send you the plans for a Pokemon Incubator by mail.^^- Leo The Pokemaniac
mail_incubator_text: Congratulations on your new Coop or Barn!^^Now that you have a proper place to care for them, it's time to hatch those Pokemon Eggs you've been keeping.^^I've enclosed the crafting recipe for a Pokemon Incubator. Build one, place an Egg inside, and with a little patience, you'll meet your new partner.^^Take good care of them!^^- Leo The Pokemaniac
mail_energyextractor_description: Hey @!^^Now that you've hatched a few Pokemon and gotten to know them, I want to share something not many breeders talk about...^^Pokemon give off a subtle energy just by being near you. It's harmless to them, but with the right device, you can gather it and put it to use around the farm.^^I've enclosed the plans for an Energy Extractor. Build one near your Pokemon and see for yourself!^^— Leo The Pokemaniac
mail_vaporeon_text: Dearest @,^^The ocean whispered your name this morning — or perhaps it was merely the gulls. A writer's mind takes liberties.^^I discovered this egg years ago, half-buried in the sand after a storm. It shimmers like the sea itself, and in quiet moments I swear I hear waves within it.^^It deserves someone whose soul runs as deep as the tide. It deserves you, my friend.^^- Elliott
mail_jolteon_text: Hi @!^^You know how much our friendship means to me. I've been studying this egg in the lab for months — its bio-electric readings are completely off the charts!^^Dad said I should entrust it to someone who'd truly appreciate how special it is. I immediately thought of you.^^Let me know what hatches. For science!^^- Maru
mail_flareon_text: Hey @!^^You know I don't do sappy letters, so I'll keep it short.^^Found this egg near the fireplace years ago. Grandpa said it was 'too much trouble.' It stays warm all the time, like it's got a fire burning inside it.^^Kinda reminded me of you. Take care of it, champ.^^- Alex

mail_sableye_text: Hey @ !^^I found this little gem-eyed Pokémon while exploring the mines. It loves precious stones, just like me. Thought you'd like it... Take good care of it, okay?^^--Abigail
mail_eeveeflareon_text: Hey @ !^^This furball gives off incredible warmth, perfect after a workout. It's full of energy, just like me! I know you'll take care of it.^^--Alex
mail_eeveevaporeon_text: My friend @,^^while contemplating the waves this morning, I met this elegant aquatic Pokémon. Its grace inspired an entire poem. May it bring you the same serenity it brought me.^^--Elliott
mail_eeveeespeon_text: Hello @ !^^This Pokémon with mysterious powers spoke to me through my dreams. Our auras vibrate in harmony... and I feel it's meant for you. Listen to what it has to say!^^--Emily
mail_eeveesylveon_text: Hi @ !^^This Pokémon is just... too cute, right? Its ribbons are adorable and it's super photogenic. I took a thousand pictures! I'm entrusting it to you, take good care of it.^^--Haley
mail_eeveeglaceon_text: Hello @ .^^I examined this Pokémon carefully: it's in perfect health, though its body temperature is surprisingly low! Fascinating. Take care of it, and don't hesitate to consult me.^^--Harvey
mail_smeargle_text: Hi @ !^^Look at this Pokémon: it paints with its tail! We spent the afternoon making art together in the forest. A true artist. I think it would be happy with you.^^--Leah
mail_eeveejolteon_text: Hi @ !^^This Pokémon generates static electricity incredibly, I took tons of measurements! A little living generator. I think you'll take great care of it.^^--Maru
mail_eeveeleafeon_text: Hello @ !^^I met this gentle Pokémon by the river. It's calm and kind, and smells of nature. The children adore it! I'm sure you'll be a good guardian for it.^^--Penny
mail_toxel_text: Yo @ !^^This little Pokémon makes a serious racket, like a living electric guitar! Perfect for the band. It needs a place to rock out... which means your place!^^--Sam
mail_eeveeumbreon_text: Hey @ .^^I ran into this nocturnal Pokémon during one of my sleepless nights. It stays in the shadows, quiet, without judging. We understand each other. I think it'll like you too.^^--Sebastian
mail_rookidee_text: Hey @ .^^This little feathered Pokémon is tougher than it looks. It always gets back up, even after a bad day. That got to me. Take care of it, would you?^^--Shane
mail_poltchageist_text: Hello @ !^^While tidying my tea room, I woke this little Pokémon nestled in an old teapot. It loves matcha, just like me! I think it'll enjoy your farm.^^--Caroline
mail_nosepass_text: Hey @...^^I extracted this Pokémon from a rock vein. Its nose always points north, like a living compass! A real gem of nature. I'd rather it be with you.^^--Clint
mail_woobat_text: Hello @ !^^As part of my research on cave fauna, I studied this Pokémon. Its echolocation system is remarkable! I entrust it to you for further observation.^^--Demetrius
mail_audino_text: My dear @,^^this adorable Pokémon has such a tender heart. It senses when you're feeling down and comes to comfort you. A little nurse! It'll bring gentleness to your farm.^^--Evelyn (Granny)
mail_cufant_text: Hello @!^^This Pokémon is sturdy and hardworking, never shy of effort. In my day, we valued those qualities. It'll be useful on the farm. Don't waste it.^^--George
mail_lickitung_text: Hello my friend @ !^^This gluttonous Pokémon tasted all my Saloon dishes... with its enormous tongue! A gourmet in its own way. I'm sure you'll feed it well.^^--Gus
mail_minun_text: Hello @ !^^Look at the little Pokémon I found! It makes sparks when it's happy. Vincent has another one, and they adore each other. Please take care of it!^^--Jas
mail_minccino_text: Hello @ !^^This little Pokémon is impeccably clean, it polishes everything in its path! A joy for the house. With two boys, I don't have time... so it's for you!^^--Jodi
mail_skarmory_text: Hello @!^^This steel-bodied Pokémon impresses me. Solid, loyal, it stands guard without ever faltering. It reminds me of my years of service. Entrust your farm to it, it'll protect it.^^--Kent
mail_mimikyu_text: Human friend @ .^^This lonely Pokémon hides under a disguise, afraid of being rejected. Like me, it only seeks a friend. You understand these things. Take care of it.^^--Krobus
mail_natu_text: Friend @ !^^This bird comes from far away, like me. It stares at the sun without blinking and knows ancient secrets. The birds told me it trusts you. Be kind to it!^^--Leo
mail_stantler_text: My friend of nature @,^^this noble deer visited me near my tent. It lives in harmony with the forest, asking for nothing. You who respect nature, I know it'll be well with you.^^--Linus
mail_honedge_text: Adventurer @ .^^This living blade only accepts worthy hands. Wield it with respect, for it drains the energy of the careless. You've proven yourself. It's yours now.^^--Marlon
mail_furfrou_text: Hi there @ !^^This adorable Pokémon has a magnificent coat that needs regular grooming. I've pampered it, but I'm short on space. You who love animals, it'll be cherished at your place!^^--Marnie
mail_golett_text: @...^^Human. This Pokémon of stone and clay was shaped by an ancient civilization. It obeys a loyal heart. The Dwarves deem it worthy of you. Take care of it.^^--The Dwarf
mail_whismur_text: Hey kid @ !^^This little Pokémon is shy, but when it's scared it wails louder than a bus engine! Ha! It cracks me up. Take care of it, it's got a good heart.^^--Pam
mail_meowth_text: Hello @ !^^This clever little Pokémon has a real business sense: it digs up coins everywhere! A nose for commerce, like me. It'll surely liven up your farm. Good luck!^^--Pierre
mail_hatenna_text: Farmer @ .^^This Pokémon perceives emotions as others perceive light. It flees turmoil and hostility. Your heart is serene enough to welcome it. Watch over it.^^--Rasmodius, the Wizard
mail_timburr_text: Hi @ !^^This burly Pokémon loves carrying beams and timber, it really helped me on my worksites! A little carpenter. It'll be valuable on your farm.^^--Robin
mail_maractus_text: Hey you @ !^^This desert Pokémon dances whenever the sun's out, it's so cute! It brightens my days in Calico. I want it to enjoy the open space of your farm!^^--Sandy
mail_plusle_text: Hi @ !^^Look at my Pokémon that makes sparks! Jas has a similar but different one. Mom says I have to share... so I'm giving it to you. But take good care of it!^^--Vincent
mail_wingull_text: Ahoy, matey @!^^This seabird has kept me company at the docks for weeks. It knows the wind and tides better than anyone. A good fishing companion. It's yours now.^^--Willy

mail_arceus_text: Dear farmer @,^^the eighteen tablets you brought me form a single set. Once gathered in the display case they began to glow, and an egg appeared at the centre of the circle. I dare not touch it. It's yours.^^--Gunther
mail_arceus_intro_text: Dear farmer @,^^I spent the night studying the tablet you brought me. The engraving matches no known script, and the stone holds a warmth I cannot explain.^^The archives mention eighteen of them, one per element. Seventeen must still lie somewhere beneath the mountain.^^I would be most curious to see what happens if they were all gathered in the same display case. Bring them to me, one by one.^^--Gunther
mail_rift_title: What comes out of the Rift
mail_rift_text: Hi @,^^word is you've been poking around Skull Cavern. Don't take it badly, nothing stays secret out here.^^The desert elders say the bottom of that pit isn't really a bottom. That the rock down there is older than the world, and that in places time gets tangled. They claim to have run into Pokémon that vanished thousands of years ago, and others nobody has ever heard of.^^I don't believe a word of it. But if you go deep enough, keep your eyes open.^^--Sandy

mail_cc_text: Dear @,^^with the Community Center finally restored, I thought it was time to tidy up the square. So I had the old truck moved, the one that's been sitting there since... honestly, I can't even remember.^^And there was this underneath. An egg. Sitting right in the middle of the dust, as if it had been waiting to be found.^^The strangest part is that the village children have been saying for years that there's something under that truck. I never wanted to listen.^^Take good care of it, I believe it's meant for you.^^--Mayor Lewis
mail_joja_text: Dear partner,^^on behalf of Joja Corporation, thank you for supporting the modernization of Pelican Town.^^Our Research division is pleased to forward a specimen from our genetic development program. The subject is stable. The equipment fitted to it is not removable and must not be taken off.^^Any behavioral anomaly must be reported. Have a productive day.^^--Morris, Joja Corporation

mail_quarry_text: @,^^now that the quarry bridge is passable, a word of caution. The tunnel opening to the west is no ordinary mine. My adventurers come back from it with scratches and stories.^^Several have mentioned symbols carved into the rock, and letter-shaped stones that come loose when a block is broken. Some swear they saw them move.^^I believe as much of it as it deserves, but take a weapon. And if you pick up one of those stones, show it to Gunther rather than to me.^^--Marlon
mail_willy_text: Hey @,^^I keep thinking about a story an old miner told me, one night when he'd had one drink too many at the saloon.^^He claimed the rivers and the sea aren't the only places these Pokémon live. That there's water deep down in the tunnels, pools nobody ever thinks to cast into, and that what comes out of them looks like nothing you'd catch in daylight.^^I laughed at the time. Now I wonder.^^If you head down there with your rod, tell me what you pull up.^^--Willy

mail_berry_text: Hi @!^^You must have run into berries around the valley by now. Don't eat them all!^^Back home, Trainers grow them: a berry holds a seed, but you need a handful to extract one healthy enough to sprout. Bring me perfect berries and you'll get more out of the same handful.^^I'm enclosing the blueprints for a Berry Press. Ordinary seed makers won't touch these berries - the shells are far too tough.^^Pierre stocks the commonest seeds and Joja followed at a steeper price, as always. But the best berries aren't sold anywhere - those you have to find yourself, and the sharper your foraging, the more you'll turn up.^^- Leo the Pokemaniac
